\begin{example} \end{example}[Thick and thin parts] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0209 1. ch31:31.40\group Margulis lemma

Simply connected manifolds are entirely thick; closed manifolds are thick for sufficiently small $\varepsilon $; and sufficiently far out in a cusp every point is $\varepsilon $-thin. \end{example}
